limitations_and_outcome_interpretation: A scalar Gaussian distance cannot represent explicit tetrahedral connectivity, stiffness transfer, surface geodesics or distinguish all topology/load paths; success supports this query summary, not the asserted mechanism.
Support union still loses individual DOFs and fourpatch identity; role coverage is sparse and nonuniform FEM-node sampling. These limitations are held fixed in the pair.
Fixed sigma is an untested bias and smooth distant-token weights may become small; a failure does not refute all query-aware conditioning, and it does not authorize a bandwidth sweep.

New learned projection and decoder slots are equal-capacity instantiated controls; gradients to query projection vanish inzero as an intended information control. The result tests the combined supplied query-context representation, not pure theoretical capacity.
Native low precision, shared optimization competition and finite budget remain possible contributors; specialist success alone does not separate them.

If train gains but validation does not, shared conditional fit improves without observed CAD transfer under this split. If neither improves, no benefit at thisfixed recipe is shown. Neither outcome automatically triggers secondseed,width/loss/attention sweeps.
Validation is adaptive research and u checkpoint selection; no finaltest, new-load result, statistics acrossseeds or new-algorithm claim follows.
